caption: The drawing features a single object, a metal container, centrally positioned on a plain, light background. The container is cylindrical with a slightly tapered middle and is rendered in various shades of brown and copper, indicating a metallic surface with a hammered texture. The top of the container is narrower than its base, and it has two rounded handles attached to its upper sides, likely for carrying. There are rivet details along the upper rim and where the handles attach. The surface of the object is mottled with small, round indentations typical of hand-hammered metalwork. The bottom of the container is rounded, and a faint horizontal seam circles the vessel about halfway up its height. The artist's name, "Edward T. Jewett," is written near the lower right of the drawing.
title: Copper Kettle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
